# tests/fixtures/documents — Generated documents

Written by `../build_fixtures.py`; do not edit by hand. One per supported format (`sample.*`), plus the hard
cases: `encrypted.pdf` (password `clearmd`), `corrupt.pdf`, `corrupt.docx`, `docx_without_extension` (detected
by content) and `zip_bomb.docx` (~60 KB on disk, 20 MiB inside).
